title: [13/10/2022] The production of perfume
prompt: The diagram below shows how oil is extracted in the production of perfume. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the process of extracting essential oils from aromatic plants to produce perfume through a distillation process.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: The process consists of four stages, beginning with heating water to generate steam and ending with the separation of two final products: essential oil and aromatic water (hydrolat).

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: The process starts when fire is applied to heat water in a container, which then generates steam. This steam passes through a chamber filled with aromatic plants, where it carries aromatic compounds from the plants along with it. At this stage, it forms a mixture of steam and oil vapor that flows into the condenser.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In the latter stages, the aromatic steam vapor moves through a condensation chamber where cold water is pumped in to cool the vapor, while hot water exits as part of the cooling process. The condensed liquid, which is a mixture of water and essential oil, flows into a separation vessel. This specialized separator uses a distinctive Y-shaped design to divide the mixture, where the essential oil is extracted through one outlet, while the hydrolat (aromatic water) is collected through another as the final product.
